facts.what: 洗牌熟练如魔术师，摊三张前手悬停一瞬
facts.anchor: Still, I do spot the tiniest glimmer of hesitation as his hand momentarily hovers before producing a row of three.

facts.what: 自认不会用塔罗，只翻过图、一直靠即兴；用传统牌（圣杯/宝剑/隐士）
facts.anchor: My problem is that I don’t know how to use them properly.

facts.what: 猜他三十出头，年长于她也可接受
facts.anchor: My prediction would be his early- to mid-thirties.

facts.what: 打断她「你是在问我还是告诉我」；她回 Telling you
facts.anchor: ‘Are you asking me or telling me?’ he interrupts.

facts.what: 解圣杯五为丧痛/失落，指出牌上另两只杯代表新机会
facts.anchor: He’s mourning over the three cups in front of him. Those cups mean loss.

facts.what: 解第二张宝剑十（背叛/苦涩）时发现他盯着她嘴唇
facts.anchor: This card can represent betrayal, bitterness

facts.what: 问她谁照顾她、有男或女伴、那个位置是否还空着
facts.anchor: ‘Who takes care of you, Cassie? Is there a man – or a woman?’

facts.what: 求 sign 无回应、脑内声音也沉默；答「只有我」；第三张翻出死神

relations: Cassie 为 Finlay 解牌；他反客为主追问她的感情状况
